sloka: हस्तिपद्य श्वपद्यौ च गोपदीं पादचूलिकाम् ।एकाक्षीमेकपादीं च पृथुपादीमपादिकाम् ।। ५.२०.३२।।।।
transliteration: hastipadya śvapadyau ca gopadīṁ pādacūlikām ।ekākṣīmekapādīṁ ca pṛthupādīmapādikām ।। 5.20.32।।।।

translations.english: O lady of dark tresses, those women who belong to me, the finest in the three worlds, will wait upon you as apsaras attend on Lakshmi.
